from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书1》')")
    legal_cause: str = Field(description="The legal cause (案由) identified in the document text or summary")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
